title: HelloMessage
description: Client to runtime, the first message on a connection (SPEC.md section 5). A request: the runtime answers with welcome or error.

version.description: The highest version of this protocol the client speaks, for example 1.0.

role.description: motion: the motion worker of the scene window (at most one per session). monitor: an observer such as the control window.

client.description: The client program and its version.

session.description: The session the client was started for. Required for role motion: the runtime refuses a motion client of another session.

versions.description: Versions of the components the client runs (renderer, physics, browser engine), for the session record. Required for role motion.

token.description: Reserved for plan item DPR-16a: the session token the runtime handed to the client. Runtimes before DPR-16a ignore it.
